newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo prosecutors arrest ex-DKB chairman Okuda.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo prosecutors arrest ex-DKB chairman Okuda.

text.p: Tokyo prosecutors said on Friday that had arrested former chairman of Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd Tadashi Okuda on suspicion of extending 11.78 billion yen in loans to racketeer Ryoichi Koike.

The prosecutors said in a statement that Okuda had extended the loans to Koike from DKB through Tokyo-based financial firm Daiwa Shinyo in about 52 installments between July 7, 1994, and September 6, 1996.

They said they had also indicted two former DKB executives for extending 7.35 billion yen in loans to Koike through Daiwa Shinyo in 28 installments during the period from July 17, 1995, to September 6, 1996.
The two former executives were Ichiro Fujita, a former DKB vice president, and Takeo Fukushima, a former DKB director.
